objective: Use newly acquired historical shot-quality information to improve pre-match1X2 forecasts over the strongest frozen goal/shot references.
horizon: Existing league-local day-start forecast cutoff; no current-match stats, xG, odds or lineup inputs. Goal/result availability remains the inherited next-local-midnight assumption. xG is delayed by7 additional full days after that midnight;14-day delay is a separately rebuilt sensitivity with identical settings, not extra model selection.
data: Exact primary Understat matches joined to unchanged canonical league/season/home/away/date/score. Only accepted_exact_join=True records enter xG training. Date-disagreed or otherwise ambiguous xG records are not used. Prediction/target population remains complete and identical to the earlier football cycle; missing xG never excludes a scored match. Original xG publication/revision times are unavailable; delays are assumptions, not timestamp proof.
selection: Same760EPL matches in2022/23-2023/24 as prior selection; correction training uses only prior resolved prequential rows across3leagues and1460days. Select minimum natural-log loss across4candidates at7-day xG delay. Advance only if relative gain>=0.5percent vs DC365/Elo50,DC180,and selected prior shot correction. Rebuild14-day features and refit the selected fixed configuration only; it must still improve every strong reference. No transfer scoring after failure.
transfer: Same2280matches across E0/SP1/I1 in2024/25-2025/26 after selection passes. Expand training with strictly earlier resolved matches; all knobs fixed. Entire cohorts and per-league/per-season results retained. These seasons were exposed in prior non-xG experiments; not pristine or prospective evidence.

xg_strength.family: Poisson quasi-likelihood log-link team attack/opponent defense/home advantage
xg_strength.target: continuous nonnegative home/away xG; treated as a mean model, not a literal count likelihood
xg_strength.fit_cadence: exact inherited approximately2month base fit cutoffs
xg_strength.unknown_teams: zero attack/defense coefficients plus learned intercept/home effect; support recorded, no invented xG observations

correction: Reuse the prior identity-shrunk multiclass log-probability offset objective with penalty0.1, training-only standardization, intercept penalized identically. Base6 features are log prior odds,DC-versus-Elo contrasts and league indicators. Add variants retain the prior4 predicted90day shot/SOT log means and append2 predicted xG log means; replace variants use2xG log means instead of4shot means. Prior DC365/Elo50 probabilities remain the logit offset. No goal outcomes are used as current xG features.
substantial_gate: At7days pooled transfer log loss must improve>=2percent vs each of DC365/Elo50,DC180,and prior shot correction, with paired28day interval upper<0 vs each. Each league and each pooled season must improve prior shot correction. Pooled Brier must not worsen prior shot correction; top-label ECE increase<=0.01. At14days the same fixed setting must improve all3strong references pooled and each league vs prior shot. Exclude documented resumed fixture as a declared diagnostic only, retaining it in the primary population. No production promotion solely from these retrospective files.

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive paired historical block bootstrap, not posterior or correction for repeated research

numerical_checks: Poisson quasi-score gradient incl penalty/intercept; exact serialized intensity replay; offset objective gradient<=1e-6; normalized positive finite1X2vectors; identity ablation reproduces prior selected shot predictions; current/future xG and outcomes cannot change earlier forecast features.
source_scope: Primary papers motivate predicting performance statistics and shot quality; this is a custom team xG mean model plus frozen-style affine probability correction, not a reproduction of their results.
